mission.title: Hotline
mission.description: Track down the E Pluribus Neo thief who ate the Merovingian's cake, and get back the maps they stole.

npc.say: Eh? What are you still doing here? Go!

phase.briefing:
The Merovingian is in a royal temper, {player}; I mean the "off with their heads" type of temper. Only certain people--such as the intangible--can go near him at times like this without risking their necks.
Oh, by the way, I need you to go receive some instructions from him. Mustn't be late!

enter.say:
Sometimes I really hate Flood.
I've got the Merv in there, and it looks like just the Twins are with him.

talk.say:
E Pluribus Neo has stolen something from me, but they also made a second mistake: gluttony. This mistake will allow you to punish them, severely.
The cake they consumed so blindly and stupidly at the scene of their crime contains a unique signature, traceable by me. As the cake becomes part of them, they become mine.
You will follow them, hurt them, and bring back what they stole.

done.say: Geez. I wonder what they stole?

near.say: Wouldn't go in there if I was you, mate.

Right across the windpipe; that's the usual way.
Now then, if you want to get fancy, you can go in behind, and then come forward... Certain advantages in doin' it like that.

phase.briefing:
Mm? Oh. They stole the maps the General's scouts had compiled of the area around the Fields. Maybe they want to go wake up all the unborn children; who knows? They're idiots, and the point is academic, anyway, since we're going to get the data back.
But it won't do to make it quick and easy for them. In fact, I think this would be an excellent opportunity to kill two birds with one stone.
No, I mean the Machines. They've been making nuisances of themselves, because they found out the General's been snooping around their precious Fields.
What you're going to do about it is to make an anonymous phone call.

enter.say: That office should be deserted. We're just going to borrow their phone for a minute.

done.say:
There's the phone.
Uh-oh, watch out for--
Oh. No, I guess it was probably nothing. Just a little jumpy, that's all. I'll feed you the location info on those EPN when you're on the line.
Stop nattering on, operative. They don't need War and Peace.

phase.briefing: If you hurry for once, you should get there in time to polish off the survivors, locate the cake-eater, and retrieve our data.

enter.say: I've got Machine and redpill signals in there in various states of health. It looks like Mr. Cake is still kicking. I'll let you know when you're close to him.

done.say:
There he is!
Oh, damn. Was. I'm not picking up our missing data anywhere around there, either.

complete.say: He'll reconstruct, you ape. Get out of there.

phase.briefing:
You didn't think reconstructing would clear our trace off him, did you?
No... Neither that nor the RSI pills it looks like he's just taken will help him. And I'll wager he's gone running back to headquarters, where they've probably got that stolen data of ours.
I just couldn't make things easier for you, could I?

enter.say:
I've got a lot of redpill signals in there.
No Machines in sight, so I guess they're all ours this time.

done.say: Well...at least that'll teach him to steal cake.

objective.text: Kill the E Pluribus Neo redpills

near.say:
Aw, forget it. There's no sign of our data there. Maybe they already sent it out. I don't know.
Yeah, I'm sure Flood will be thrilled.
What the hell? You?! Get away from me!

mission.finish:
They didn't have the data? But I...ah... We... You'd do best to avoid the Merovingian for the time being, {player}, until I manage to sort this out. You're lucky you have me watching out for you.
Oh, but here's some exciting news to dispel the gloom of your dismal failure: the General's had to pull back from the Fields, what with the Machines looking all over the area for his Sentinels. I always said it was a massive waste of time. Fat lot of good that map would do anyone, anyway.
